question:
Register the verification-gate output of each instance, or re-read the vendor page. State whether it still answers and what it accepts.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/bitiful $.egress.terms: The pricing page supports 10 GB a month free and 0.26 CNY/GB as the first paid step. It does not state the 5 GB a day cap or the 11 to 1000 GB band; those are only on the transfer-prices page (sha256:6b767a9d..., claim c01). A fresh read on 2026-11-04 returned the same capture.
- netdisk-pan/cstcloud-data-capsule $.limits[1].value: The page supports the upload-size half of the value. It says nothing about the account total being set by identity verification: there is no quota, capacity or 实名 text on the page (fresh read on 2026-11-04 identical).
- netdisk-pan/cstcloud-data-capsule $.limits[1].value: Same as c07: the clause that the account total is set by identity verification is not on this page.
- netdisk-pan/guangyapan $.tooling: The open API document supports v1.3, updated 2026-09-20, Device Code and Web OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, and write capabilities off by default per app. It does not mention the OpenList guangyapan driver, WebDAV or 302 links, the two-stage SMS login with X-Captcha-Token and X-Device-Sign, or CloudDrive2 v1.0.1
- netdisk-pan/samsung-cloud-storage $.chaining: The notice supports the 2026-09-30 end of Gallery sync with OneDrive and that synced files stay in OneDrive. It does not say that Samsung-side storage is gone, does not say 'personal' OneDrive, and has no 15 GB figure; those clauses need another source.
- netdisk-pan/samsung-cloud-storage $.chaining: This support page supports the redirect to the personal OneDrive account only. It does not state that the Gallery sync ends on 2026-09-30 (that is on the samsungcloud.com notice, sha256:032dce46...), nor that Samsung-side storage is gone, nor the 15 GB figure. A fresh read on 2026-11-04 was identica
- netdisk-pan/telnyx-cloud-storage-egress-view $.free_tier.stated: The rate card states no free tier: no 10 GiB free allowance, no free operations and no EU/US split. The free tier is on the billing docs page (sha256:c47ba8b7..., claim c24). A fresh read on 2026-11-04 was identical.
- netdisk-pan/telnyx-cloud-storage-egress-view $.egress.price_per_tb: The rate card says egress fees are None, so the egress price per TB is 0. USD 0.006/GiB is the storage rate (| Storage | $0.006 per GiB (billed monthly) |), not an egress rate; and 0.006 x 1024 GiB is 6.14 per TiB, not per TB (per TB it is about 5.59).
